proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for synclounge, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the synclounge service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the synclounge
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  synclounge:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.synclounge.loadbalancer.server.port=8088
      - traefik.http.routers.synclounge.rule=Host(`synclounge.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.synclounge.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.synclounge.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.synclounge.service=synclounge
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.synclounge.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.synclounge.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Synclounge: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-synclounge/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - readOnlyRootFilesystem is supported by this image; enable it once /config and /tmp are mounted.
#   - runAsNonRoot is supported by this image (set runAsUser and drop PUID/PGID).
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: synclounge
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: synclounge
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: synclounge
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: synclounge
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: synclounge
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/synclounge:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        ports:
        - name: port-8088
          containerPort: 8088
          protocol: TCP
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: synclounge
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: synclounge
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: synclounge
  ports:
  - name: port-8088
    port: 8088
    targetPort: 8088
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# synclounge.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-synclounge/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Synclounge (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/synclounge:latest
ContainerName=synclounge
AutoUpdate=registry
# Environment=AUTH_LIST=plexuser1,plexuser2,email1,machineid1
PublishPort=8088:8088

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
